content.body: The M9 Bazooka entered US service in the fall of 1944. Featuring several improvements over the M1, its M6A3 rocket used a shaped HEAT charge that could penetrate as much as 3 inches (76 mm) of armor.
content.brief: WEAPON: M9 Anti-Tank Rocket Launcher AMMO: 2.36" M6A3 HEAT Rocket (4) MUZZLE VELOCITY: 80 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-shot OTHER EQUIPMENT: M1911A1 Automatic Pistol .45 cal Combat Knife
